# lemonai 2026.07.02

- [Lemon AI​ is the first Full-stack Open-source Self-Evolving General AI Agent, offering a ​fully local alternative​ to Agentic platforms like Manus & Genspark AI. It features an integrated Code Interpreter VM sandbox for safe execution.​​](https://github.com/hexdocom/lemonai/blob/main/README.md)
